detail.longDescription: I am using Plotly/Dash to build a web app. I want to upload a file and for that I am using html.Button() from dash import Dash, dcc, html from dash.dependencies import Input, Output import plotly.express as px app = Dash() # Create the layout of the app app.layout = html.Div([ html.B('Please select a file'), html.P(), dcc.Upload( id="upload-data", children=html.Div([html.Button('Choose File')]), multiple=False, ) ]) if __name__ == '__main__': app.run(debug=True) Output: The code works well, but I notice that clickable area of the Button exceeds the breath of the Button. When I click within the area of Button 'Choose File', import window opens and that's what is expected - OK When I click just above or below the Button, the import window doesn't open. This is also as expected - OK But when I click just on the right side of the button, the window opens as well - not OK How to restrict clickable area to the Button only? I tried many things with style , but nothing has worked. For example: html.Button(..... style={"display": "inline-block"} ) What changes do I need to make?
